# Python Automation Bot

## Project Description
A Python automation bot that collects information, generates a daily summary, and runs automatically using GitHub Actions.

## Features
- Fetches daily information
- Generates automated summary
- Creates daily summary file
- Uses GitHub Actions for automation

## Files

- bot.py - Main automation script
- daily_summary.txt - Generated output file
- .github/workflows/bot.yml - Automation workflow

## How to Run

Install dependency:

pip install requests

Run:

python bot.py

## Automation

The bot runs automatically through GitHub Actions.
